1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents __with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting a batch of the bankruptcy documents for filing with the different bankruptcy organizations__.

2. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the proofs of claims __by electronically transmitting a batch of the proofs of claims to the different bankruptcy organizations for filing__.

7. (Previously presented) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy __with the plurality of different bankruptcy organizations__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a __secure file transfer protocol (SFTP)__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site __from the plurality of creditors__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day __with the plurality of different bankruptcy organizations__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising: generating a report __regarding filing of the proofs of claims__; and sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim __from one of the different bankruptcy organizations__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer __that electronically transmits the proofs of claims to the different bankruptcy organizations__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __before automatically generating the proofs of claims__.
